purpose: Customer login gate for final order placement while allowing ungated product exploration, cart review, and checkout review.
businessRules: Customers can browse the storefront, view cart, view wishlist, and review checkout without logging in.
Login is required before final confirm-and-pay, saved addresses, or account-specific workflows.
Login navigation must preserve browser cart state so customers can return to checkout with the same items.
Identity input must use shared email-or-Indian-mobile regex validation.
OTP input must accept exactly 6 digits using the shared OTP regex.
Login posts through /api/customer-login to SHRESTA-BE and stores the backend session token only in an HTTP-only cookie.
Local/dev/UAT may expose the seeded test login helper; production builds must not show seeded credential help unless explicitly configured for UAT.
